Question Choices: Select. Liam is visiting China and wants to buy a t-shirt that costs 200 Chinese yuan. He has 30 US dollars. If 1 US dollar can be converted into 6 Chinese yuan, does Liam have enough money to buy the t-shirt? ~~Yes | No~~
Hints: Use the rate given in this problem, then compare the exchanged amount with the stated price.
Solution: At the stated hypothetical rate, 30 x 6 = 180 yuan before buying. Compare 180 with the 200-yuan price: not enough, so No.
